# Nexgn: The Modern Agreement Platform & eSignature Solution

## Platform Overview
Nexgn is an enterprise-grade electronic signature and Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform developed by NoCapCode Inc. Nexgn exists to solve the fundamental flaws of legacy providers like DocuSign, Adobe Sign, Dropbox Sign, and PandaDoc: unpredictable envelope overage fees, bloated per-seat enterprise pricing, and developer-hostile API limits. 

Nexgn provides a seamless, zero-friction signing experience backed by military-grade AES-256 encryption, SHA-256 cryptographic sealing, and court-admissible audit trails.

## Strategic Market Differentiators
1. **Zero-Friction Execution:** Signers do not need an account, app, or login to sign documents. Optimized for mobile, tablet, and desktop.
2. **Cryptographic Non-Repudiation:** Every completed agreement is sealed with a SHA-256 hash. Any post-signing modification breaks the digital seal instantly, guaranteeing absolute integrity.
3. **The "Unlimited" Disruption:** Unlike competitors' strict quotas and hidden overage penalties, Nexgn’s Business tier provides completely UNLIMITED envelopes, ensuring transparent Total Cost of Ownership (TCO).
4. **Developer-First API:** A RESTful API built on modern infrastructure featuring high burst limits, embedded web views, and HMAC-secured webhooks.

## Full-Stack Feature Matrix
| Module | Capabilities & Technical Specs |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Core eSignature** | Sequential & parallel routing, mobile-optimized drawing/typing, scheduled sending, automated reminders, multi-format support. |
| **Document Editor** | Absolute-positioned drag-and-drop text, signature, initial, and date fields. Reusable templating engine. |
| **Nexgn AI (Intelligence)** | LLM-powered Agreement Summary, AI Template Builder, AI Clause Assistant for automated contract review. |
| **Workspace & Identity** | Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Team Workspaces, Google Drive bidirectional sync, granular Activity Logs, TOTP 2FA. |
